source: derived from the author's published preamble (profiles/typography/sources/free_snacks.tex) + canon://aesthetics/typography_and_layout + canon://aesthetics/tikz_guidelines
_house_layer_note: the emitted preamble carries \usepackage{eigen-revtex} (templates/eigen-revtex/); every package in `packages` that the layer provides (tex_template.LAYER_PROVIDES) is trimmed at emit so the emitter and the check_template gate agree. Packages remain listed here as the profile's full intended stack.

equations.punctuation: equations punctuate as clauses of the sentence

figures.captions: caption is the figure's only prose surface (the no-titles law); panel labels \textbf{(a)}, \textbf{Top:}; epistemic type declared where panels mix evidence classes
figures.assets: vector-first (pdf); generated TikZ diagrams disfavoured for data figures
figures.grid_convention: any time-grid panel shows scaled Gauss-Hermite nodes, never uniform ticks

tables.environment: table* with ruledtabular for wide comparisons
tables.units: stated in column heads, never repeated per cell

bibliography.footnotes: bibfootnote class option carries asides as citations

colour_policy: colorlinks; Nature-style muted colours in any TikZ (blue!80!black class, never raw primaries)

source_organisation.fragments: one .tex per section, % PLAN/% NODES markers preserved
